evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of intermittent palpitations.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 82 bpm. Normal axis.
PR interval 184 ms, QRS 90 ms, QTc 424 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes and no acute changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
55%. Mild mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.
